caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass jar with a wide, cylindrical body and a slightly rounded bottom featuring some internal curves. The jar has a reddish-brown, tightly fitted lid that appears opaque and covers the opening. The jar is empty, and the transparency of the glass is indicated with shaded and highlighted areas in light blue, gray, and white, giving it a reflective quality. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. Near the bottom of the image, there are a few handwritten numbers and words in pencil and red ink, as well as a small circular symbol or initial in the lower left corner.
title: Shaker Sugar Jar
